test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In May 2025, India approved the execution model for which indigenous fifth-generation fighter aircraft program?

options.text: HAL Twin Engine Deck Based Fighter (TEDBF)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **AMCA** is India’s indigenous fifth-generation fighter aircraft program aimed at developing a stealth multirole combat aircraft with advanced technologies.
 
• The fighter is designed with features like stealth capabilities, supercruise, advanced avionics, and a highly integrated weapons system.
 
• **AMCA** will be equipped with twin engines and is intended to replace older aircraft in the Indian Air Force's fleet.
 
• The project is spearheaded by the Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA), under the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), with manufacturing support from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL).
 
• The AMCA program is a vital step in strengthening India’s defense capabilities and achieving self-reliance in defense technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stealth Technology:** Stealth technology in fighter aircraft minimizes radar cross-section (RCS), making it difficult for enemy radar systems to detect the aircraft.
 
• **Supercruise:** This refers to an aircraft’s ability to cruise at supersonic speeds without using afterburners, enhancing fuel efficiency and operational range.
 
• **Fifth-Generation Fighters:** These are advanced multirole aircraft featuring stealth, advanced avionics, data fusion, and enhanced maneuverability.
 
• **Indigenous Defense Development:** India’s focus on developing indigenous defense systems is part of the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative to achieve self-reliance in defense production.
 
• **Global Context:** Other countries with fifth-generation fighters include the USA (F-22, F-35), Russia (Su-57), and China (J-20), reflecting the strategic importance of such aircraft in modern warfare.
